info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Documents API
Generates a url to upload a document into AppZen repository.

items.docs:
This is first part of a two part process for uploading a document into AppZen repository.
1) Generate URL
    ```

    curl --location \
      --request GET 'https://<api-gateway-url>/dictionary-data-services/generate-upload-url' \
      --header 'x-api-key: <x-api-key>' \
      --header 'customer-id: <customer-id>' \
      --header 'customer-key: <customer-key>'

    ```
2) The JSON reponse contains three elements.
    A `uuid` field contains the identifier of the document to be uploaded.
    A
